output_categories.note: classification output vocabulary, not keyword lists: step 0 of the rubric is a relevance gate - records matching the broad net but concerning material/component/infrastructure ageing or other non-ageing uses of matched terms get 'not_relevant'; 'ambiguous' is reserved for on-topic but undecidable records. See KEYWORDS.md.

meta.recovery_command: atlas lives at data/Track3_C2/output/ (byte-identical to the 2e59b27 blobs; 4061bff deleted only a duplicate top-level Track3_C2/ copy); history fallback: git show 2e59b27:data/Track3_C2/output/{swecris,cordis,nih_reporter}.csv
meta.matching: whole word/phrase, case-insensitive; '*' in a keyword matches any word-character suffix; spaces match any whitespace
meta.precision_proxy: share of a keyword's matching records whose llm_category equals the keyword's category; LLM labels are unverified, so this is a proxy, not ground truth

sv.note: only 38 of 2,944 records are Swedish-language, so Swedish stats are thin

thresholds.note: every kept keyword with fewer than 5 hits, in either language, carries low_evidence: true; spelling variants (variant_of) skip only the hit-count floor and must still meet min_precision

meta.principle: search broad (category-agnostic ageing net below), classify precise (the classifier assigns categories using the per-category keywords)
